name: nea-backend
description: Nea (SIH 2026, PSID 198, team Fremen) — backend workspace. Single env file: backend/.env. node-api owns auth/DB/chat/voice/memory; ai-service is the ML risk classifier only. `npm start` runs both.

scripts.install:python: python -m pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt --break-system-packages
scripts.install:all: npm run install:node && npm run install:python
scripts.start: concurrently -n node,risk -c blue,green "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:risk"
